patches.value: Use xv=0 from H005 for the bottom raising endpoint. Derive the basic x,y,h actions from the string identities, then iterate and divide by factorials to obtain both integral binomial formulas, including the zero branches. Package N001.

PENDING_AUDIT_B. Use action endomorphisms of the complex sl2 module; the three Chevalley brackets and common invariant subspaces encode its representation and irreducibility. lam remains an integer; l=lam.toNat and Idx l=Fin(l+1), with H003 justifying the identification. M is a Z-submodule of V (equivalently an additive subgroup). R is the subring of Q generated by fractions with p-prime denominators; T005 proves it is exactly Z_(p). MR is its span inside V; T006 constructs the tensor identification, not an assumed embedding. Jc is initially a span, and T009 proves its exact coordinate-set meaning. All tensor spaces are scalar-first: VK=K tensor_Z M is the canonical flip of the source M tensor_Z K. FirstChange/ScalarData record checked natural maps, not assumptions. IntegralOps records restrictions and their inherited brackets, whose existence is proved in T007; baseChange gives the tensor-induced action. All result structures are witness records and their existence is a step obligation. Finite pi types encode the finite direct sums. Integer/natural casts in Actions explicitly encode the integral coefficients; ext extends a finite basis by zero only for writing boundary formulas.
